title: Consistency of DES and DESI distances and the Standard Cosmological Model (Watkins, Trueax, Feldman)
efc_relevance: DESI DR2 recovers the CMB-anchored combination (r_d h)(Omega_m/0.3)^0.4 with sub-percent precision and the high-z DES SN sample is fully ΛCDM-consistent; the paper argues that the apparent evolving-DE preference is driven by a systematic ~0.05 mag offset in the low-z DES anchor sample. Critical caveat for EFC's L2→L3 framing: if the SN systematic is confirmed, the empirical case for dynamical DE — and the prior weight that lifts EFC — weakens substantially. Reference baseline for any EFC w_0 w_a publication.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as systematic-caveat row; update WP3 Falsification Protocol with the 0.05-mag low-z SN systematic note; cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2), arXiv:2605.27221 (DES Y6 multi-probe) and arXiv:2606.05853 (bin-free w(z)); flag in Likelihood Ledger that EFC's (w_0, w_a) report must state whether the low-z DES anchor systematic was marginalised.
